question: Should `findOpenAIStrictSchemaViolations` become a supported public Plugin SDK API, or should this PR keep it internal to the AI package as its stated no-surface-growth goal implies?
rationale: A public Plugin SDK export is a durable compatibility commitment; the code and PR description point in opposite directions, so a maintainer must choose the intended contract before merge.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove the Plugin SDK re-export and update tests to consume the AI-internal implementation, preserving the stated no-new-SDK-surface boundary.

options.title: Approve a public diagnostic API
options.body: Retain the export only with explicit ownership, compatibility documentation, and focused public-contract coverage for its future behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Remove the Plugin SDK re-export and update tests to consume the AI-internal implementation, preserving the stated no-new-SDK-surface boundary.
